# routeros_interface_wifi_radios (Data Source)
Read `/interface/wifi/radio` on RouterOS 7.25.1+. [CLI reference](https://manual.mikrotik.com/docs/7.25/cli-reference/interface/wifi/radio/).

## Example Usage
```terraform
data "routeros_interface_wifi_radios" "radios" {}

# Each data row includes radio_mac, hw_caps, ml_group, and supported bands.
# Radios sharing an ml_group can participate in MLO when hardware permits it.
```
